evidence.title: AutoForm - Instant forms for your schemas

name: AutoForm
summary: React library that renders forms automatically from Zod, Yup or Joi schemas, with official shadcn/ui and MUI packages.
description: Point AutoForm at an existing validation schema and it maps fields to the right input components, connects them to your form library and sets up validation — a drop-in form builder for internal tools and simple forms. Official packages cover shadcn/ui, Material UI, Mantine, Ant Design and Chakra UI, plus React Hook Form and TanStack Form; fieldConfig options and custom renderers stay open for overrides. A skill is available for AI coding assistants.
contains: renders forms from Zod, Yup and Joi schemas
official packages for shadcn/ui, Material UI, Mantine, Ant Design and Chakra UI
works with React Hook Form and TanStack Form
fieldConfig and custom renderer escape hatches; can sit inside dialogs
AutoForm skill for AI coding assistants
